show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: SPECIAL ANNOUNCEMENT: CAU for IR/BD Professionals
transcript:
thrilled to announce our first Capital Allocators University for investor relations and business development professionals.
Your role is one of the toughest in our industry. It's often hard to know how to move the ball forward when allocators are busy and opaque about their process.
So we've created a Capital Allocators University experience just for you.
On December 3rd and 4th in New York City, I'll be joined by your peer and superstar,
Rahul Mudgal, branding expert Jen ProSec from ProSec Partners, conference guru Ron Biscardi from
My Connections, ProSec managing partner and longtime Milken team member Katie O'Reilly, and investment
leaders, Sarah Samuels from NEPC, Dave Moorhead from Baylor, and Shannon O'Leary from the St. Paul and
Minnesota Foundation. We'll help you learn best practices for understanding allocators, developing relationships
with investors and building a brand through workshops and peer discussions.
We're excited to share what we've collectively learned about how to perform in the role and drive
drive results for you and your firm. You can learn more and sign up to attend at Capitalallocators.com
slash university. Hope to see you in New York in early December for our first Capital Allocators
University for investor relations and business development professionals.
